notices.title: 10.27.26 City Council agenda
notices.agenda_text:
AMERICAN FORK CITY COUNCIL 
OCTOBER 27, 2026 
REGULAR SESSION AGENDA
	


*Notice of Electronic Meeting*

One or more City Council members may be physically absent from this meeting but may participate electronically.

The American Fork City Council will meet in a regular session on October 27, 2026, in the American Fork City Hall, 31 North Church Street, commencing at 7:00 PM. The agenda shall be as follows:

PUBLIC HEARING
1.	Receiving public comments on the declaration of vehicles to be surplus.

REGULAR SESSION
1.	Pledge of Allegiance; Invocation by Council Member Carroll; roll call.
2.	Twenty-minute public comment period - limited to two minutes per person.
3.	City Administrator's report.
4.	Council reports.
5.	Mayor's report.

COMMON CONSENT AGENDA
(Common Consent is that class of Council action that requires no further discussion or which is routine in nature. All items on the Common Consent Agenda are adopted by a single motion unless removed from the Common Consent Agenda.)
1.	Approval of the October 13, 2026, city council minutes.
2.	Ratification of city payments (October 7, 2026, to October 20, 2026) and approval of purchase requests over $50,000.

ACTION ITEMS
1.	Review and action on a resolution accepting the petition for the American Heritage Plat B Annexation, located at approximately 1200 East 700 North and consisting of approximately 0.91 acres.
2.	Review and action on a resolution accepting the petition for the Christensen-Harbor Road Plat A Annexation, located at approximately 800 South 100 West and consisting of approximately 9.6 acres.
3.	Review and action on approval of a reimbursement agreement with Rockport Industrial for sidewalk improvements on Storrs Avenue.
4.	Review and action on the first amendment to the interlocal cooperation agreement 2024-385 between Utah County and American Fork City for the American Fork 200 South 300 West Intersection Project.
5.	Review and action on an ordinance approving a Code Text Amendment, amending Section 17.7.602 - Planned Shopping Center Projects - of the American Fork City Municipal Code. The Code Text Amendment plans to propose Veterinary Clinics as a permitted use with the SC-1 Zone.
6.	Review and action on an ordinance approving a Code Text Amendment, amending Section 17.21.030 Landscaping Requirements. The Code Text Amendment plans to increase the lawn areas for Institutional Uses (churches, schools, etc.).
7.	Review and action on an ordinance to amend Section 17.6.101 of the American Fork City Municipal Code. Amending Section 17.6.101, the Code Text Amendment plans to amend the Site Plan Approval Process.
8.	Review and action on a resolution approving the declaration of property to be surplus and disposed of.
9.	Review and action on approval of an ordinance amending Chapter 2.43 of the American Fork City Code titled 'Policies and Procedures Manual.'
10.	Review and action on approval of updates to the American Fork City Policies and Procedures Manual.
11.	Review and action on approval of a resolution revising the pressurized irrigation shareholders discount agreement.
12.	Consideration and action on entering into a closed session to discussion pending or reasonably imminent litigation as described in Utah State Code 52-4-204 and 52-4-205. 

ADJOURNMENT

Dated this 23rd day of October 2026.

/s/Terilyn Lurker, City Recorder

-	In accordance with the Americans with Disabilities Act, the City of American Fork will make reasonable accommodations to participate in the meeting. Requests for assistance can be made by contacting the City Recorder at 801-763-3000 at least 48 hours in advance of the meeting.
-	The order of agenda items may be changed to accommodate the needs of the City Council, staff, and the public.
-	Persons addressing the Council during public comment may submit written materials to the City Recorder. When practicable, the Recorder shall distribute copies to the Council or provide them electronically after the meeting. Submission of written materials does not require the Council to review, discuss, or respond to the materials during the meeting. The presiding officer may impose reasonable, content-neutral limitations regarding the format, number of copies, or method of submission to ensure the orderly conduct of the meeting.

notices.title: 10.27.26 Public Hearing - Vacation of ROW
notices.agenda_text:
NOTICE OF INTENT TO VACATE A PARCEL WITHIN A RIGHT OF WAY
AND PUBLIC HEARING

Notice is hereby given that American Fork City will hold a public hearing on Tuesday, October 27, 2026, at the American Fork City Hall, located at 31 North Church Street, commencing at 7:00 p.m. The purpose of the public hearing is to receive public comments on the vacation of a parcel within a right-of-way at approximately 10 West and 1200 South. 

The legal description is as follows: 

A parcel of land being part of an entire tract of land described in that Warranty Deed recorded
December 27, 2021 as Entry No. 212962:2021 in the office of the Utah County Recorder. Said
parcel is located in the Southeast Quarter of Section 26, Township 5 South, Range 1 East, Salt Lake Base and Meridian described as follows: 

Beginning at the southeasterly corner of Deer Park Drive (1230 South) road dedication plat recorded November 6, 2023 as Entry No. 72759:2023, having Map No. 18981 in the office of said Recorder, which is 616.14 feet S. 89°00'19' E. along a monument line and 1738.82 feet North from a Reference Monument to the South Quarter Corner of said Section 26; said point also being 532.74 feet S. 89°48'53' E. along the Section Line and 1668.17 feet North from South Quarter Corner of Section 26; thence N. 00°27'17' E. 54.88 feet to the northeasterly corner of said Deer Park Drive (1230 South); thence S. 65°12'39' E. 14.10 feet along a southeasterly extension of the northeasterly line of said Deer Park Drive (1230 South) to a easterly boundary line of said entire tract; thence S. 00°03'35' W. 55.05 feet along said easterly boundary line to intersect a southeasterly extension of the southwesterly line of said Deer Park Drive (1230  South); thence N. 65°12'39' W. 14.51 feet along said extension to the Point of Beginning. 

Containing 0.016 acres, more or less. 

Copies of the proposed vacation are available at the City Administrative Offices, 51 E. Main Street.  All interested people are invited to attend and make comments.
Dated this 15 day of October, 2026.

 
Terilyn Lurker
City Recorder

Notice of Ordinance Adoption

Notice is hereby given that on September 22, 2026, the American Fork City Council adopted Ordinance No. 2026-09-22 which approved amendments to Chapter 12.12.030 titled Sidewalks and Frontage - Cleaning by Property Owner. This clarifies the owner or occupant of a property is responsible for maintaining the entire frontage of the property, including front, side, and rear yard. The ordinance is available for public inspection during normal business hours (Monday through Thursday 7 a.m. to 6 p.m.)

Dated this 23rd day of September 2026

/s/Terilyn Lurker

notices.title: 09.08.26 Public Hearing - Chipman/Stake Center Annexation
notices.agenda_text:
Public Hearing Notice - Chipman/Stake Center Annexation
Notice is hereby given that a petition for annexation was filed with American Fork City. The petition, which was accepted by the city council on July 28, 2026, covers approximately 24 acres consisting of property located at 510 South 100 West. The city recorder certified the petition, and the legislative body provided notice according to Utah Code 10-2-807. A 30-day period was allowed to give property owners and affected entities the opportunity to submit written protests.
A public hearing will be held on Tuesday, September 8, 2026, at 7 p.m. at the American Fork City Hall (31 N. Church Street) to allow the public to comment on the Chipman/Stake Center Annexation. After the public hearing, American Fork City may choose to deny or grant the petition and annex the area described in the petition. 
The complete annexation petition is available for inspection and copying at the American Fork City Recorder's office (51 E. Main Street, American Fork) or by emailing tlurker@americanfork.gov
Dated this 25th day of August.
/s/ Terilyn Lurker, City Recorder
